children: Euro-denominated debt supply is projected to rise over the coming year, Deutsche Bank credit strategists say in a note. Debt supply by AI-related companies is expected to continue, as is supply by nontech companies, the strategists say. Deutsche Bank forecasts new euro investment-grade issuance--bonds issued by companies deemed low-risk and financially stable by rating agencies--could reach 755 billion euros in 2027. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
